scope: Frame-alignment audit of tactical, broadcast and Smart Tagging inputs, and an opt-in broadcast-cutaway stoppage cue. Inputs only: tracking, homography validity and tags; no video frames, labels, public-window scores or hand choices. Offsets are discovered by code at runtime.
rules_checked: RULES.md allows any algorithmic use of provided data; forbids hand labels/corrections and rules or constants tied to specific frames. Broadcast is optional input with no provided mapping.

broadcast.note: Video container has one frame fewer than tracking; only the final record is affected. Players are present in 91% of invalid-homography frames but the ball almost never (0.8%).

broadcast_to_tactical.method: Player-formation matching (mean capped nearest same-team distance); global vote for offsets, per-frame verification within +-3 frames, bracketed coverage.
broadcast_to_tactical.within_half: Constant offset with 1-2 frame drift; 5 s ball-trajectory windows confirm +-1-2 frame jitter and no persistent steps (no dropped or inserted frames). Replays replace live footage in real time.
broadcast_to_tactical.halftime_edit: Broadcast cuts away ~74 s before the first-half end and shows ~23 s of unmatched pitch footage; live second-half footage resumes 130 s after the tactical second-half start. Tactical 88712-90651 and 110808-114048 have no broadcast coverage, nor do the last 38 s of the match.

smart_tagging_timing: Throw-in tags hit the touchline equally at -2..+2 s shifts and degrade beyond +-10 s; consistent with the documented seconds*25 mapping at seconds precision.

set_piece_tag_follows.note: Only 5 free-kick tags exist, so foul stoppages are mostly untagged.

cue: Dead evidence 0.9 across covered broadcast no-pitch runs >= 5 s, truncated at a tagged restart or when the observed tactical ball moves >= 12 m/s over 0.2 s for 3 frames. Thresholds fixed a priori; 0.2 s speed span introduced to fix a 0.25 m-noise robustness failure.

trial.external_metrica_dfl: Byte-identical (no broadcast view externally); the cue cannot be validated against possession truth.
trial.robustness: 133/134; only the prototype dead-share drift guard fails (0.171 > 0.05).

decision: Promoted by the user as the working default; contact-carry CSV kept as rollback (submissions/possession_contact_carry_fallback.csv, 44dd3c69...).

replay_extension_trial.method: Broadcast frames with pitch view but no live formation match are searched against the preceding 3 minutes of tactical play; a match (<=1 m) marks a replay, which then counts like a cutaway.
replay_extension_trial.detection: 9% of other-view frames match an earlier moment (median 19 s earlier); 0/300 live-view controls do. Broadcast tracking follows the screen, so replays describe the past.
replay_extension_trial.decision: Not promoted: open-play tag coverage (0.60) is far above the promoted cutaway frames (0.30), suggesting some replays overlap resumed play; effect is 0.45% of graded frames. Flag broadcast_replay_enabled stays off.

runtime: Offset discovery, per-frame verification and replay search run in forked worker pools with identical results; full default pipeline 75 s (was ~7 min).
